import pandas as pd

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_degrees_conferred.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2022 Table 318.10', header=None)
data = df.iloc[4:68].copy()
data['year'] = data[0].astype(str).str.strip()
years = ['2010-11', '2011-12', '2012-13', '2013-14', '2014-15', '2015-16']
subset = data[data['year'].isin(years)].copy()
subset[1] = pd.to_numeric(subset[1])
top3 = subset.sort_values(by=1, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3['year'].tolist()
